metaDescription: Order custom NFC enabled badge reels for secure access. Perfect for modern workplaces. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom NFC enabled badge reels combine the convenience of retractable badge holders with the security of near-field communication technology. These reels allow employees to tap their badges for door access, time tracking, or contactless check-ins without removing the badge. Ideal for tech-forward companies, they can be decorated with your logo using screen printing or full-color imprinting. Choose from durable metal or high-impact plastic reels with various cord lengths to match your workplace needs.
heroAltText: Custom NFC enabled badge reels with retractable cord and embedded NFC chip for secure access
